fields.System.Title: RPL-3 — Executing tasks
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Get the replenishment task into an operator's hands and the stock into the pick face, with the
move properly recorded.

Scope

In. Assignment, scan confirmation of source and destination, completion, partial
replenishment.

Out. The stock move itself — executed by
[INV-301](../../stories/INV/INV-301-move-stock-between-locations.md).

Design notes

Same scan discipline as picking. Source location, product, destination location. A
replenishment confirmed without scans is a stock movement recorded on trust, and it corrupts
two locations when it is wrong.

Lock the task on assignment. Two operators sent to the same bulk pallet is the same defect
as two pickers on one task — one arrives to find the work done, or both confirm and the
movement doubles.

Partial replenishment is normal, not an error. The source pallet may hold less than the
need, or the pick face may fill up. Record what actually moved, close the task, and let the
next trigger decide whether more is needed.

Prioritise tasks that block a released wave. A replenishment completing after the wave has
been picked is a wasted trip and the pickers already shorted.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Two operators claiming the same task | [doc 09 §4.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Replenishment completing after the wave is picked | [doc 09 §7.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Confirming without scans | [doc 05 WF 11](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
